hostContract.renderer: actual pinned shared Dva WebGPU renderer, ready, device epoch >=1
hostContract.mainTarget: registerTarget with sampleable:true, physical backing width/height, exact logicalWidth/logicalHeight and generation
hostContract.frame: actual renderer.beginFrame(); frame.clear(main target) precedes record; host submits actual frame afterward
hostContract.atlas: actual HTMLImageElement decoded from hash-verified existing alpha PNG; actual player createTextureCache uploads it; materialFor source/cache identity is checked
hostContract.currentState: exact targetLease; ownerAlive/ownerVisible/connectedVisible from owned preview fixture; isCurrent checks owned clock generation, visibility, resize and disposal
hostContract.source: explicit previewOnly:true; type:'alchemy-excalibur'; id/playerId/roomId/localGeneration/startedAt/duration>=1200; immutable cause object retained for lifetime
hostContract.command: real registered atlas body command with exact crop and authored sourceSize; rigid/registered motion sprite.transform; origin is crop bottom center; exact pose1 same-atlas extension; action === command.exAction
hostContract.clock: host-owned elapsed/E clock; eAgeSeconds=elapsedMs/1000; action progress separately from 620ms motion lifetime; caller supplies actual releaseBoundary (R10 .52)
hostContract.holds: held flag changes matching completed frame uniforms; no synthetic accepted release; hold after release boundary must still encode and complete a real release frame
hostContract.replay: retire old source before new replay cause; use new clock generation/currentState; prepare updates current target set; old pending callbacks become invalid
hostContract.cleanup: host closes its resources; bridge.destroy waits queue before scratch/registration cleanup; bridge does not destroy renderer or shared cache

methods.prepare: await prepare({viewport,sourceIds,prewarmCommands}) -> target allocation receipt or false; source cap32
methods.recordTail: same arguments but no command/action; only private release accepted by real completedFrame.accept + actual proof.done + all three null error scopes may drive tail
methods.retire: retire(sourceOrId) invalidates own preview ledger and pending commit callbacks
methods.onCommitted: preview-frame-completed callback includes scope, edition, source, packet, releaseAccepted, completedFrame, isCurrent, eAgeSeconds, poseIndex, targetGeneration, uniformBytes

recordedPath: world MRT: main and source rgba16float attachments, original WORLD_WGSL
observer+displayed backdrop snapshot rgba16float attachments, original OBSERVER_WGSL wrapped with sealed engineering wrapper
shared renderer encodeLinearHDRLayer into exact physical target
renderer owns submit/errorScopes/queue completion and completed-frame proof
submissionCompletion: Each actual onSubmitted callback returns its proof-gated promise; the shell returns the host completion promise to the preview clock. Only a real renderer completed-frame proof can invoke onCommitted.
startup: Parent playing/ready notification is emitted only after real completed-frame acceptance and current visible target/cause checks; startup token, version, and attempt epoch are exact.
timing: Preview-only selected-rate authored time pauses during actual submission/proof backpressure. Wall duration and render wait are separate; no performance or real-time acceptance.
